courses.title: Box select: inside or touching
courses.objective: Drag a rectangle over the model to select faces, edges, bodies or sketch shapes. Left → right selects what is completely inside; right → left selects everything the box touches.

steps.title: Build the part
instructions: A plate with a hole is built.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Start Box select
instructions: Choose the Face filter, then press Alt+X (or AakarFORM › Pick › Box). The cursor becomes a cross.
steps.why: The filter decides what the box selects: Face, Edge, Body — or sketch shapes when sketches are selected.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Inside only
instructions: Drag from the upper-left to the lower-right around the whole plate: only faces completely inside the box are selected (blue box).
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Touching
instructions: Drag from right to left across part of the plate: everything the dashed green box touches is selected.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Add with Shift
instructions: Hold Shift while dragging to add to the selection. Esc stops box select.
steps.why: Build up a selection in several boxes. Only visible faces are taken, so the faces behind are left alone.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.
